description: Given one sample document's `text`, propose a reusable JSON Schema for that document type. Use this when no built-in schema_id fits: infer a schema once, review it, then reuse it as `schema` on parse_document / parse_text across many documents for consistent output. Returns the JSON Schema plus a flat field list and an inferred doc_type. Costs 1 credit per successful call.

doc_type.description: Optional hint for what kind of document this is, e.g. "purchase order", "lab report".

instructions.description: Optional guidance on which fields matter or how to shape the schema.

text.description: A single representative sample of the document type, as text.

name: infer_schema
title: Infer a reusable JSON Schema from a sample
